description: One primary owner for every file of the event build. Generated by requirements-compiler v41 from analysis/project-structure.json, the v4 verification plan (one file per test file a bound test names) and v4.1's contract, state-machine and unit tests. A file owned by ui-2 belongs to ui in a topology without a ui-2 lane (ownerByTopology). A non-owner changes a file only through a pull request its owner approves; integration alone writes shared files and project files; every Compile list is written once, complete, at bootstrap.
rules: A file has exactly one primary owner; contributors may edit only through a pull request the owner approves, never concurrently.
A change to a frozen interface (interface-specifications.json) goes through the coordinator and is versioned; consumers are notified before merge.
F# compile order is the order of each project's files list; a file may depend only on earlier files of its project or on referenced projects.
ui and ui-2 never own the same file; Shell.fs is ui's and ui-2 consumes it read-only.

Integration alone writes: .gitignore, every project and solution file, Directory.*.props and .targets, NuGet.config, global.json, package.json, package-lock.json, playwright.config.ts, *.runsettings, build.fsx, README.md, .github/, .echelon/, tests/fixtures/, tests/browser/support/, web/boundary.js, src/Causa.Host/, src/Causa.App/View.fs and src/Causa.App/Program.fs (check X02). web/index.html and web/causa.css are ui's (T16).

playwright:invariants/INV-10.spec.js > tabs independent with and without navigator.locks [chromium]
playwright:invariants/INV-21.spec.js > no credential in storage, URL or artifact [chromium]
